# assets/generated/

**Do not edit by hand.** These SVGs are written by the GitHub Action
`.github/workflows/update-profile.yml` (running `scripts/generate-profile.mjs`)
on a schedule, so the figures are always real and current.

| File | Content |
|------|---------|
| `stats.svg` | snapshot of public contribution / repo / language stats |
| `languages.svg` | top public languages by bytes |
| `activity.svg` | recent contribution activity |

Until the first CI run, the root README references the live
`github-readme-stats` endpoints directly — those also pull **real** data from
the GitHub API at render time, so nothing fictional is ever displayed.
